description: List journal entries. Paginated. Brief view omits postings; use view='full' for headers or get_journal for postings.

date_from.description: Only journals with effective_date >= this (YYYY-MM-DD). Filters by effective_date; narrowed server-side.

date_to.description: Only journals with effective_date <= this (YYYY-MM-DD). Filters by effective_date; narrowed server-side.

modified_since.description: Return only objects modified since this timestamp (ISO 8601)

operation_type.description: Filter by operation_type (e.g. INITIAL for UI-managed opening balances, ENTRY, TRANSACTION, SALE_INVOICE, PURCHASE_INVOICE)

per_page.description: Items per page when filtering (default 100, max 500)

view.description: Response detail: brief (default) returns triage fields; full returns every API field.

name: list_journals
title: List Journals
